description:
The plot illustrates the relative change of different configurations across layers. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from Layer1-4 to Layer29-32, with tick labels at each layer. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and has a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. A dashed grey horizontal line is present at 0%. 

The line representing “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” is colored yellow, uses circular markers, and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 0.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -1.5% at Layer5-12, then increases to approximately 0.5% at Layer29-32. The line representing “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit” is colored red, uses square markers, and is a solid line. It begins at approximately -0.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -2.5% at Layer5-12, remains relatively steady around -2% until Layer21-28, and then increases to approximately 0.5% at Layer29-32. The line representing “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” is colored light blue, uses circular markers, and is a solid line. It begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -6% at Layer5-12, then increases to approximately -1% at Layer29-32. The line representing “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit” is colored dark blue, uses square markers, and is a solid line. It begins at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -11% at Layer13-20, and then increases to approximately -1% at Layer29-32.
